errors.evidence: In comparing Jakarta to Hanoi (Vietnam) and Jakarta to Naypyidaw (Myanmar), the additional east–west difference (Jakarta being around 106.85° E and Naypyidaw around 96.08° E) shows that Jakarta–Naypyidaw is farther apart than Jakarta–Hanoi.
